[SWS_SM_00658] Transition to Restart state for StateMachine of type Controller
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
Modelled Process controlling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
, during a call to
ResetMachine
method, shall transition the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
to
the
Restart StateMachine State
.
⌋
[SWS_SM_00661] Set ResetMachineNotifier to kRejected
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
If
ResetMachine
is called outside an update session
Modelled Process
control-
ling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
shall set the Field
ResetMachineNoti-
fier
to
kRejected
.
⌋
Update session ends with a call to
StopUpdateSession
method. At that point the
Machine
is in an undefined state.
StateMachines
may have been installed, up-
dated or removed. Depending on the changes done during the update, the
StateMa-
chine States
and their
ActionLists
managed by the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
may have changed as well. To counter this situation the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
needs to retake full control of the
Machine
and transit it to a well
defined
StateMachine State
.

⌈
The configured
StateMachine
of type
Con-
troller
shall have corresponding
AfterUpdate StateMachine State
config-
ured, at the time when the creation of the manifest is finished.
